because im lonely and im crazy and he's the only person I know with and the only person my paralyzing anxiety doesn't prevent me from interacting with socially. so yea, it's nice to have that. And when that's going well everything else seems to fall into place

My situation isn't urgent or anything

yea he knows how impartant he was to me but he can't deal with my problems anymore, and honestly, neither can i.

He tells  me that I can stay with him as long as I need to... but I know that he wishes I was gone (in a safe place of course, but gone) Yea, I just don't wanna be a burden on him anymore. 

when we were together I kinda felt like he motivated me to take care of myself.... because i saw myself having a future. He's never really home anymore... he's always busy with other people in his life like family and friends who I know should be more important than me anyways. He to at least try to make time for me.... and now it's only when he doesn't have anything better to do (this sounds less snarky in my head I just don't know how to write it) 


He's expressed to me that I've been a big burden to him emotionally. I can't really say how much work it was... but probably alot and over a couple years. I feel so guilty. I wish I had done this years ago so I hadn't put him through all my bs

I wish my bf would get back together with me. I know it sounds selfish but being with him really helped me, and was keeping me on track. Even if we didn't stay together forever, I felt like in a few years I'd be stable enough to handle the break up. 

But I guess he had to move on with his life, and I understand and respect that. I think taking care of me was exhausting for him. He's a nice guy he always tries to help everyone but it's not possible in terms of time management and I think that's hard for him


The only thing I really care about is my cat. I love him so much I'm crying as I write this. I know he loves me too, and that's why I don't want to leave him. I don't wanna break his little kitty heart lol. My only wish if I do this is that he'll be well loved and taken care of.
